value.rationale: PASS: Exact sparse constant-weight deletion capacity is a natural information-theoretic optimization, not an arbitrary enumeration. Weight one has capacity one, whereas weight two is the first layer with growing capacity; this solves every blocklength with sharp 3/4 linear leading coefficient and periodic endpoints, plus an elementary extremal construction. The proof identifies why two mechanisms—packing singleton-output positions and forbidding adjacent loop positions—control the optimum.
